caption: The drawing depicts a garment, specifically a fitted bodice, shown from both the front and back views. The forefront bodice is rendered in a dark purple color with shading to suggest folds and contours, a high collar, long sleeves, and a row of buttons running asymmetrically from the neckline down to the side. The lower portion of the garment and the skirt are outlined in pencil without color. To the right, there is an outline sketch in pencil showing the rear view of the same bodice, indicating the lines of construction and draping at the back, as well as the outlines of the skirt. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color. The artist’s signature, “MELITA MORGAN,” appears in small print in the lower right corner of the paper.
title: Basque
